# Crayon Roofing & Structures — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary
This corpus is a large mixed bag of call snippets. A majority are **internal-ops noise** — Diwali gift-distribution runs, driver/loading coordination, attendance/location pings, bill-copy handovers, and repeated duplicate recordings. After filtering these out, the **genuine sales material** that remains is moderate in volume but reasonably rich: dozens of real customer enquiries (walk-in callers and WhatsApp-routed leads), several B2B dealer/distributor negotiation calls (screw and welding-rod reseller), rate-quote exchanges, and a handful of complex order-processing calls involving custom-cut accessories (L-flash, cutters, gutters). There are also a few long consultative calls with fabricators (puff panels, polycarbonate/Lexan). Given the heavy skew toward non-sales chatter, conclusions below are grounded strictly in what the surviving sales calls actually show — no roofing-only assumption, no invented SKUs or policies.

## Products & brand ladder
Based only on calls where products/rates are actually discussed:

- **Metal roofing sheets (core product)** — profiled/corrugated color-coated sheets, various thickness: 0.45 mm, 0.47 mm, 0.50 mm, 0.60 mm (no 0.7 mm stock mentioned when asked). Brands referenced as being produced/traded by Crayon or its sourcing partners:
  - **JSW Color On Plus** (flagship, most quoted) — e.g. "JSW point 47... 420 + GST square meter rate"
  - **JSW Pragathi / Pragati Color On Plus** — slightly higher than Color On Plus: "Pragathi rate...445 + GST square meter rate sir"
  - **Asian / Indra Dhanush** — cheaper alternative: "thickness வந்து 0.45 mm Asian Indradhanush brand இருக்கு...1251 + 18% GST"
  - **JSW Radiance**, **Silver On Plus** — mentioned as alternates, Silver On Plus "கொஞ்சம் விலை அதிகம், JSW Steel கொஞ்சம் விலை கம்மி"
- **Tile-profile sheets** — handled by "another factory," not the Manali metal-roofing line; customer referred there: "நம்மளோட இன்னொரு factory-ல tile profile sheet-ஓட இது இருக்கு."
- **PUFF (insulated) panels** — roof & wall, 50 mm/40 mm/30 mm thickness, color-coated both sides: "புஃப் 50 mm வரும்... square meter-ல வரும்... ₹1650 + tax."
- **Polycarbonate / Lexan sheets** — clear, 1.5 mm/1.8 mm/2 mm standard (10 mm clear also discussed as a separate enquiry); max standard length "15 அடி தான் standard."
- **Roofing accessories** — L-flash, ridge, gutter, crimp/cutter end-caps — custom cut-to-size, priced by standard width (610 mm) vs full-sheet usage.
- **Screws** — Tata Agri-brand self-drilling/self-tapping screws in various sizes (25 mm, 55 mm/M8, 1 inch, 2 inch, rust-free variants), sold by carton.
- **Welding rods** — Tata and "Rashi" brand, sold by box/carton, with periodic dealer schemes.
- **MS Channels** — JSW/JSBL brand structural channels (125/65 mentioned).
- **Not stocked / redirected elsewhere:** UPVC sheets, liner sheets, GI sheet in 80/120 GSM spangle grades, MS corrugated 1.2 mm — in each case the rep clearly says "நம்மகிட்ட available இல்லை sir."

Manufacturing location consistently cited: **Manali, Andarkuppam check post, Chennai** — the only branch; no Coimbatore/Hyderabad presence despite enquiries from those regions.

## Real rates & terms (only rates that actually appear in the calls)
- JSW Color On Plus 0.47 mm: **₹420 + GST / sq.m**
- JSW Pragathi Color On Plus: **₹445 + GST / sq.m**
- Asian Indra Dhanush 0.45 mm Pragathi: **₹370–410 + GST / sq.m**
- Example 10-ft sheet price (Color On Plus 0.47): **₹1,466 + 18% GST**
- Asian Indra Dhanush 10-ft sheet (cheaper tier): **₹1,251 + 18% GST + loading charge**
- Kg-based pricing quoted alternately: **~₹118–120/kg + GST**, with "running meter weight" conversion ~4 kg/sq.m for 0.47 thickness
- Polycarbonate/Lexan 2 mm: **₹800 + GST / sq.m**
- PUFF panel, 50 mm: **₹1,650 + GST / sq.m** (~₹2,000 all-in with GST, by running meter)
- Accessory cutter/L-flash standard width 610 mm: **₹655** per piece; exceeding 610 mm triggers "full sheet use" = **double rate**
- Screws: 25 mm Tata — ₹2.93 + tax (later corrected to ₹3.08); 2-inch Tata — ₹4.44 + tax (dealer)/₹4.66 + tax (rust-free, consumer); 1-inch — ₹2.93+tax
- GST is **always 18%, non-negotiable**: "with GST தான் full-ஆவே" — no cash/no-GST billing offered.
- **Payment terms (quoted explicitly twice):** 50% advance, balance 50% before delivery/dispatch: "50% advance payment, balance 50% வந்து delivery-க்கு முன்னாடி payment பண்ணனும்."
- **Transport/freight is excluded**, customer's scope: "vehicle உங்க scope தான் வரும்."
- Lead times: coil-dependent stock items ~4–5 days + ~2 days dispatch (~1 week total); polycarbonate/accessory custom orders "maximum 1 week"; small accessory jobs same/next-day if stock ready.
- Price increases are flagged informally to distributors ahead of official notice ("20th தேதிக்கு மேல rate increase ஆகப்போகுது").
